description: Joins the HAR network log and DOM snapshots into an explicit causal chain. For each action where a network response completed and the DOM mutated within ±100ms, returns the triggering request URL, response status, body snippet, and the exact DOM nodes that appeared or disappeared. Background polling and analytics pixels are filtered out. Use to diagnose race conditions and async rendering bugs — removes hallucination from the question 'did this fetch cause this DOM change?'

trace_path.description: Absolute path to trace.zip, or a URL (https://) to download it from

name: correlate_dom_and_network
